summary: security checked in 2 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed, not clear. Fleet-doctor has no run or findings; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error sweep results; security sitefacts are unknown for all 61 in-scope sites; and authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness are therefore unevidenced. Compliance records 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown, which is a technical baseline rather than certification. No TLS certificates are reported as expiring within 30 days, but this does not evidence complete TLS configuration. Risk severity: high for clearing new public exposure or security-sensitive releases because material controls cannot be verified; no evidence of compromise is present. Exact decision: keep private-launch and security-sensitive release gates unchanged; reject new security-sensitive production exposure, credential/permission/configuration changes, dependency additions, and deployments until dated control evidence and owner-approved disposition exist. Permit ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior and passes existing validation gates. Continue the existing read-only security evidence work; do not create duplicate telemetry or security work.

Security recommends evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance. Before any new public exposure or security-sensitive release, attach dated evidence for authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container/runtime isolation, release and deploy controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure boundaries, monitoring and incident signals, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Current fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results, so absence of findings must not be treated as clearance. Preserve the existing capacity-gated CTA work only as ordinary reversible growth; do not add credentials, permissions, dependencies, telemetry, or cross-site behavior.
